pkgmetadata.longdescription: F3D (pronounced `/fɛd/`) is a fast and minimalist 3D viewer desktop application. It supports many file formats, from digital content to scientific datasets (including glTF, USD, STL, STEP, PLY, OBJ, FBX, Alembic), can show animations and support thumbnails and many rendering and texturing options including real time physically based rendering and raytracing. It is fully controllable from the command line and support configuration files. It can provide thumbnails, support interactive hotkeys, drag and drop and integration into file managers. F3D also contains the libf3d, a simple library to render meshes, with a C++17 API, C, Python, Java and Javascript Bindings.

use.flag: Support for FBX, DAE, OFF, DXF, X and 3MF file formats
Support for clipboard interaction using provided clip
Support for encoding animations to video files with media-video/ffmpeg
Support for VTKHDF (.vtkhdf), ExodusII (.ex2), and NetCDF (.nc) file formats
Support for STEP, IGES, BREP, and XBF file formats
Support for Point Cloud file formats
